standard.summary: 开启后 DDP 每步遍历计算图，找出这一步没参与反向的参数。默认关闭。
standard.effect: 直接传给 DDP 包装器的 find_unused_parameters。开启时 DDP 会在反向开始前扫一遍计算图，把没用到的参数从这一步的梯度同步里排除掉。
standard.whenToUse: 模型里有条件分支、某些层只在部分步参与计算，训练报 “Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration” 时开启。
standard.avoidWhen: 没报过那个错就不要开 —— 每步多一次图遍历，纯粹是白花的开销。

standard_en.summary: Once on, DDP walks the graph every step to find parameters that did not take part in that step's backward. Off by default.
standard_en.effect: Passed straight through to the DDP wrapper as find_unused_parameters. When on, DDP scans the graph before backward begins and excludes the unused parameters from that step's gradient synchronisation.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on when the model has conditional branches, some layers participate only on some steps, and training reports "Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration".
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not turn it on without that error -- the extra graph walk each step is pure overhead.

advanced.principle: DDP 在反向开始时假定所有注册的参数都会拿到梯度，靠这个假定把梯度分桶后一次性 all-reduce。若某步有参数没参与反向，桶永远等不满，下一步就会报 reduction 未完成。find_unused_parameters 让 DDP 先遍历一遍 autograd 图，把这一步用不到的参数标记掉。
advanced.intervention: distributed_runtime.py 在包装 DDP 时直读这个键传给 DDPModelWrapper(find_unused_parameters=)，与 ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view / ddp_static_graph 是同一组 wrapper 参数。
advanced.expectedImpact: 开启后每步多一次计算图遍历，通常是个位数百分比的步时代价；换来的是有条件分支的模型能跑起来。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 ddp_static_graph 语义相反：static_graph 承诺图不变，find_unused_parameters 承认图会变。两个都开时 PyTorch 以 static_graph 为准，等于这个键被忽略。
advanced.codePath: configs_base.py:ddp_find_unused_parameters 声明；distributed_runtime.py 直读并传给 DDPModelWrapper；三分叉 S_DISTRIBUTED 暴露（2026-09-05 补齐，此前三个 wrapper 参数只暴露了两个）

advanced_en.principle: At the start of backward, DDP assumes every registered parameter will receive a gradient, bucketing gradients on that assumption for a single all-reduce. If some parameters don't participate in backward on a step, the bucket never fills and the next step reports an unfinished reduction. find_unused_parameters makes DDP traverse the autograd graph first and mark the parameters unused that step.
advanced_en.intervention: distributed_runtime.py reads this key directly when wrapping DDP and passes find_unused_parameters= to DDPModelWrapper — same wrapper-parameter group as ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view / ddp_static_graph.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Adds one graph traversal per step, usually a single-digit-percent step-time cost; in exchange, models with conditional branches can run at all.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Semantically opposite to ddp_static_graph: static_graph promises the graph is fixed, find_unused_parameters admits it varies. With both on, PyTorch honors static_graph — this key is effectively ignored.
advanced_en.codePath: configs_base.py:ddp_find_unused_parameters declaration; distributed_runtime.py reads directly and passes to DDPModelWrapper; exposed in the three-way S_DISTRIBUTED fork (added 2026-09-05; previously only two of the three wrapper parameters were exposed)
